# Next.js adapter — banned APIs. Format: <extended regex><TAB><use instead>.
# A match in any adapter .md is an error unless the line says why (removed / deprecated / instead / not supported / never use / do not use).
# Next.js 16 caching
revalidateTag\([^,)]*\)	use revalidateTag(tag, 'max') instead, or updateTag(tag) / refresh() in Server Actions
export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache|runtime) *=	route segment config not supported with Cache Components; use 'use cache' + cacheLife()/cacheTag() instead
unstable_cache	use 'use cache' + cacheLife() + cacheTag() instead
next: *\{ *(revalidate|tags)	use 'use cache' + cacheLife() + cacheTag() around the fetch instead
experimental\.(dynamicIO|useCache)	use cacheComponents: true instead
# Next.js 16 routing / tooling
middleware\.ts	use proxy.ts exporting proxy() instead (Node runtime only)
export (async )?function middleware	use export function proxy() instead
next lint	use ESLint CLI instead: "lint": "eslint ." (codemod next-lint-to-eslint-cli)
from 'next/router'	use next/navigation (App Router) instead
runtime *= *'edge'	Cache Components and proxy reject runtime config; use default Node.js runtime instead
# next/image
(<Image[^>]* priority|^ +priority( |$)|`priority`)	use preload prop on next/image instead
onLoadingComplete	use onLoad instead
# Zod 4
\.flatten\(\)	use z.flattenError(error) instead
\.formErrors\b	use z.flattenError(error).formErrors instead
error\.errors\b	use error.issues instead
z\.string\(\)\.(email|url|uuid)\(	use z.email() / z.url() / z.uuid() instead
# shadcn/ui forms
<(FormField|FormItem|FormControl|FormMessage)\b|components/ui/form'	use Controller + Field / FieldLabel / FieldError instead
# Tailwind 4
@tailwind (base|components|utilities)	use @import "tailwindcss" instead
tailwind\.config\.(js|ts|mjs|cjs)	use CSS-first config in app/globals.css (@theme inline) instead
hsl\(var\(--	use OKLCH values on :root/.dark + @theme inline { --color-x: var(--x) } instead
# React 19 / testing
useFormState	use useActionState from react instead
setupFilesAfterFramework	use setupFilesAfterEnv instead
collectCoverageFrom=?'?src/	use collectCoverageFrom: ['{app,components,lib}/**/*.{ts,tsx}'] instead
ts-jest	use next/jest.js (SWC transform) instead
